Kestrel Studio

$49 one-off licence. Download the installer for Windows, macOS or Linux. System requirements: 8 GB RAM. Release notes in the changelog.

What Kestrel Studio does

Kestrel Studio is a desktop editor for building and testing data pipelines. It opens a project folder, shows every step of a pipeline as a node on a canvas, and runs the pipeline locally against sample data so you can watch the output of each step change as you edit it. Configuration is stored as plain files in the project, so a pipeline built in Studio can be checked into version control and run headless on a server without Studio installed.

The licence is perpetual for the major version you buy and includes twelve months of updates. It is a single-user licence, activated online on up to two machines at once; deactivate one machine from the account page to move the licence to another. A free trial runs for fourteen days with no feature restrictions.

Requirements

Windows 10 or later, macOS 12 or later, or a 64-bit Linux distribution with glibc 2.31; 8 GB of memory and 500 MB of disk space.
